summary.text: John Vincent is a retired U.S. Navy Command Master Chief and small business owner running as the Democratic nominee for South Carolina's 7th Congressional District.
He launched his campaign in April 2025.

paragraphs.text: Vincent is from Myrtle Beach. Ballotpedia lists his birthplace as Arkansas, while the SC Daily Gazette described him as a native of Long Island, New York.
He served in the U.S. Navy for about 20 years, retiring in 2003 as a command master chief petty officer.
He was stationed at the former Charleston Navy base from 1983 to 1992.
After leaving the Navy, Vincent worked seven years in Florence as a sales manager for WBTW-TV and built and ran a small business.
He earned a degree from the University of Arkansas at Grantham.
He co-wrote a book on diversity and inclusion with his wife.

sources.title: Navy veteran hopes to be first Democrat this century to represent Grand Strand, Pee Dee in Congress
